characters.

swordmaster, but their thing is axes and
battleaxes of different types and
fighting styles.  Axes, in general, are

can't block as easily, but with a good
swing can cut deeper.  Axes are also less

begin with, and inflict critical hits
that really hurt.
>

<dgnInfo:
    Magic Blooded humans of the Ten
Worlds are a little different when
compared to the more often-found human
beings of the Ten Worlds are.\\LB
    Regular humans of the Ten Worlds are
descendents of mundane human beings of
planet Earth, which left their home world
centuries ago in a mass exodus where they
were forced to find a new place to live
for not only themselves, but all life of
Earth.  Space aliens known as architects
and their ten planets welcomed this life
of Earth, and to make a long story short,
ended up terraforming their ten worlds to
accept, keep, and take care of all life
of Earth origin for all time from then
on, as part of an arrangement the
architects agreed to and seemed to think
would be a good idea for not only
themselves but also life from Earth,
given some rather complicated
circumstances that needed solutions.\\LB
    Life of Earth, at that time, was out
of options and needed a place to live,
and the Architects needed their own
problems solved.  The spirit of Earth and
Earth's sun made a bargain with the ten
worlds of the architects, and so the
architects gladly transformed their ten
worlds to have breathable air exactly
like that of Earth, along with oceans,
lakes, and soil to grow crops and plants
in that would fully support all life
from Earth.\\LB
    The architects also permanantly
changed their own bodies and species,
becoming people who would live among
people from Earth, as fellow citizens,
and as their own species but resembling
human beings very closly, as friends who
agreed to forever after look after and
take care of all life from Earth.\\LB
    People from Earth were gifted with
a change to their spirits and their
nature, gifts from Earth and Earth's sun
that made humans forever onward magical
and having magic to their spirits, from
one generation to the next, and also
living on as not only enchanted humans
but also seperating into multiple races
of people that included humans as well as
elves, orcs, dragon people that looked
like humans, etc.  With these gifts,
people that were descendants of humans of
Earth to begin with had access to magic,
and abilities to cast magic spells, etc.,
while still having modern technology such
as televisions, computers, etc.\\LB
    Magic blooded humans are an offshoot
of Ten World humans that have a much
greater amount of magic to their nature
than ordinary humans do.  They find it
easier to cast spells and wield magic in
various ways, and their stronger
spiritual nature not only comes with a
boost to their magical potential, but
also an increase to their physical
strength, speed, and reflexes, and so on.
They also tend to be a much healthier,
happier people who live better lives, and
can do more things than ordinary humans
can.\\LB

    Orcs of the Ten Worlds are a strong,
fast, muscular and athletic metahuman
race of people that are an enchanted
offshoot of the Ten World human species.
Compared to Ten World humans, they do not
typically have better magical
potential, but they are physically
superior in that they have far more
physical muscular strength combined with
superhuman speed, manual dexterity, and
reflexes.  Intellectually they are just
as intelligent as Ten World humans,
although they coincidentally do take
more time to develop and learn skills
and experience, making them require more
experience points to level up in any
character class compared to humans.  This
does not mean that they are dull, dumb,
or slow on the uptake compared to humans,
at all.  Also, their social skills are
just as good as Ten World humans.\\LB
    Compared to humans, orcs have
tougher skin and bone that can handle
physical injury and damage better than
that of a human.  As such they will of
course take more of a beating from an
enemy's physical attacks before being
defeated in combat.  Also, their
non-human tougher skin, combined with
their digestive and immune systems,
resists poisons, venoms, non-magical
diseases, and biological toxins better
than that of a human.\\LB
    Orcs of the Ten Worlds are easy to
identify for what they are,
species-wise, as they have fangs among
their lower teeth that are where a human
would have the lower canine teeth, and
they have ears that are pointed.\\LB
    Many orcs happily live in the same
towns, cities, and communities as Ten
World humans do, easily integrating
themselves with humans, making good
neighbors and friends with them and
sharing the same culture, traditions,
humor, television shows, music, and
recreation as humans.  Such orcs have
personalities that are, more or less,
the same as that of humans.\\LB
    Like other metahumans, both orcs and
half orcs are also sometimes found in
their own communities, towns and
villages where the population is mostly
or completely exclusively their species.
Orcs and half orcs that live in these
types of communities usually maintain a
culture and lifestyle that mirrors that
of human and mixed-species towns and
cities, unlike elvish towns and dragon
boy villages, which typically have a
culture and lifestyle of its residents
that is different and unique.\\LB
    When building an adventuring party at
the beginning of the game, orcs will of
course make good warriors with swords and
axes of kinds, much better than that of
human characters, although when it comes
to spellcasters they will not do any
better, if at all, than human characters
will.  If a party has other characters
that are non-human and good at magic,
orc characters can complement the party's
members with good non-magical physical
warriors that use guns, and especially
swords and axes.\\LB

humans of Earth did not have.\\LB

remembered in their history textbooks
they have while growing up and going

ancient Earth would call a soul, was

Earth in origin by planet Earth itself

leaving Earth for the Ten Worlds and
never to return.\\LB

well-rounded can potentially be

the game with a party made up of mostly
